releaseNotes: PRVN Music v0.11 (Build 14): Complete Play Together Rebuild & Music Engine Integration. Play Together now runs on PRVN Music's unified Discover & YT Music pipeline and single Player engine; real-time song requests (Pending, Accepted, Added to Queue, Played, Rejected, Cancelled) with host Accept/Reject/Queue notifications; SQLite persistence across reconnects; monotonic sequence sync engine with RTT latency compensation and accurate sync status; prvn:// invite deep linking; shared queue management; host room controls; updater cache hardening.
